$comment: Migrations that cannot be rolled back automatically. Every entry MUST reference a reviewed runbook file (relative to this directory). The rollback check fails if a migration has no down.sql and is not listed here, or if a listed runbook is missing.

irreversible.reason: Rewrites AuditLog into a partitioned table and copies rows across. The reverse requires recreating the unpartitioned table and copying data back under operator supervision.
Installs audit triggers and revokes direct DML on AuditLog. Reverting the grant posture is an attended security operation.
Enables row-level security and tenant-isolation policies across core tables. Disabling RLS in production is an attended security change.
Adds the 'Draft' value to the LoanStatus enum. PostgreSQL cannot remove enum values, so this is irreversible without recreating the type.
